premises.text: Shopping data collection is one-sided: vendors amass and leverage tracking data while consumers forget purchases and lack leverage
premises.evidence_span: it's one-sided. Those with the vendors are the only ones that can be amassing and leveraging and tracking the data

premises.text: Consumers forward order confirmations into Schwab to capture purchases and augment them with why/need stories for mindful taste signaling
premises.evidence_span: all I need to do is forward my order confirmations in my inbox to wowat12.com

premises.text: Purchase history can be sliced, mashed with analytics (e.g. weather), shared to social, and ingested via Shopify plugin across many stores
premises.evidence_span: I can start to slice it by when, where, what time, also by what I needed at the time

premises.text: Personal RFP / data-out portability lets consumers opt-in share chosen purchase history with brands for personalized deals, loyalty, VIP, and search results
premises.evidence_span: the data actually gets powerful when the customer can take all that they've amassed and leverage it back for something of value in return

value.text: Consumers gain vendor-like leverage over their shopping data for personalized value in return
value.evidence_span: what if the consumers had as much leverage with the data as the vendors do?

secondary_value.text: More mindful shopping via why-behind-purchase storytelling
secondary_value.evidence_span: We want consumers to be a little more mindful of what they're shopping for

causal_links.evidence_span: Those with the vendors are the only ones that can be amassing and leveraging and tracking the data
we're augmenting the basic purchase data, the stuff that's like the what, the how much sort of thing, with the why, the real personal story behind what we're buying
leverage it back for something of value in return, better deals, loyalty points, VIP programs

notes: Data-in capture (forward confirmations + why tags) and history analytics/share/Shopify ingest folded as facets of consumer capture toolset; personal RFP data-out split as speaker-framed grander vision module that could fail independently (§4.1.5). Retailer 'powered by' interest folded lightly into data-out partnership path, not separate premise. ASR Schwab/Schwope/Schwelp kept in spans.
